referee_caveats_inferred: Streamer parameters (Table 1) are hand-tuned with an extra 1.5 factor on free-fall velocity; no goodness-of-fit, so streamer-type classification is qualitative.
Warm-spot Tex of Oph IRS 63 rests on low-S/N SO2 lines (some S/N ~2.5-3 in moment maps) and the quoted 20% uncertainty is not a fit error; N(SO) uses the SO2 Tex by assumption.
Centrifugal barrier radius is inconsistent: 30'' (~65 au) in Sect. 2.3 is likely a typo for 0.3-0.5'', and the summary quotes ~80 au.
SW-boundary SO-CO offset is given as 0.7'' +/- 0.01'' in the text but 0.75 +/- 0.05'' in Table 2.
DK Cha inclination from a marginally resolved continuum (minor axis 0.38 +/- 0.11'') is weak; the rotation direction is unresolved, so streamer geometry there is speculative.
The inner-envelope model is not fitted to data with a likelihood; the claim of its necessity vs. a pure CMU model with disk surface shocks is not tested quantitatively.
Sample of three sources chosen from incomplete observations and selected by SO/SO2 detection, which may bias conclusions about how common the features are.
